name: American Sign Language, isolated words (WLASL2000, SL-GCN, AI4Bharat OpenHands)

source.paper: Selvaraj et al., OpenHands, ACL 2022. https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.05877

wlasl100.description: The 100 glosses of the WLASL100 split. Restricting the choice to these is a SANGAM option; its accuracy has not been measured.

licence.dataset: WLASL is released under the Computational Use of Data Agreement (C-UDA 1.0) for academic and computational use only; the WLASL page states: No commercial usage is allowed. https://dxli94.github.io/WLASL/
licence.weights: Trained on WLASL. Because of the dataset's non-commercial terms SANGAM does NOT bundle these weights. The installer downloads them from the official AI4Bharat release only after the person running it accepts the WLASL terms (--accept-wlasl-terms).
licence.attribution: WLASL: Li, Rodriguez, Yu, Li, WACV 2020. Model: AI4Bharat OpenHands (Selvaraj et al., ACL 2022).

dataset.name: WLASL2000
dataset.signers: 100+ signers, videos collected from the web

evaluation.publishedByAuthors: Top-1 accuracy 30.6% on the WLASL2000 test split (OpenHands paper, Table 2, SL-GCN). Low: most single predictions over 2000 signs are wrong.
evaluation.measuredBySangam: None on real signing. SANGAM verified only that its JavaScript inference equals PyTorch on the released weights.

architectureDescription: SL-GCN: Decoupled spatial graph convolution + 9-frame temporal convolution, spatial/temporal/channel attention, 10 blocks (64-64-64-64-128-128-128-256-256-256 channels, stride 2 at blocks 5 and 8), global average pooling, linear classifier. Source: AI4Bharat OpenHands openhands/models/encoder/graph/decoupled_gcn.py and decoder/fc.py (Apache-2.0).
input: One isolated sign: T frames x 27 keypoints x (x, y), from MediaPipe Holistic (75 points = 33 body + 21 left hand + 21 right hand, undetected parts = 0), PoseSelect preset mediapipe_holistic_minimal_27, CenterAndScaleNormalize on the shoulders at clip level.
output: One logit per vocabulary entry; SANGAM applies softmax and its own acceptance thresholds.

preprocessing.normalisation: centre = mean shoulder midpoint over the clip; scale = 1 / mean shoulder distance over the clip

granularity: isolated word/gloss (one sign per clip). Not fingerspelling. Not continuous signing. Not sentence translation.
notes: Never used for ISL. ISL and ASL are different languages; the two models have separate vocabularies and are never mixed.
Contains YES, NO, HELP, HELLO, THANK YOU among its 2000 glosses.
